mobile_scope: Chromium device emulation; no physical-device claim
method: tools/check_browser.py over an unmodified Python SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, headless Edge, native CDP touch emulation.

coverage.desktop: Static initial view; all controls; canvas-only keyboard shortcuts; pause/reset; responsive resize.
coverage.reduced_motion: System preference on initial load; four shape/palette combinations; static clicks/finale; toggle while playing.
coverage.lifecycle: Visibility and pagehide/pageshow transitions; preserve manual pause; no duplicate animation frame chains after rapid toggles.
coverage.mobile: 390x844 DPR3 and 844x390 emulation; backing store capped at DPR2; tap, touch cancel, multi-touch, vertical scroll and long press.
coverage.fallback: No JavaScript, missing config and unavailable Canvas retain preview and source links with controls disabled.
coverage.gallery: 28 cards; home and artwork01 card both open the playable page.

python_suite.skip_reason: Optional existing Tk font-boundary desktop check was not enabled in this run.

other_checks.desktop_formula_review: 12 seeded bursts across all four shapes and 4032 trajectory evaluations equal original desktop code.
other_checks.existing_gallery_smoke: Featured/search, desktop controls, GIF and mobile layout pass.

limitations: Mobile checks emulate Chromium; physical Android and iOS phones were not tested.
Safari and Firefox were not tested.
Browser and Python share formulas but use different random generators and rendering; pixel identity is not claimed.
Test-group seconds describe checker runtime, not rendering performance.
